tools.description: Save and build a complete mechanism definition as an undoable design revision. Optional draft_id combines staged source changes and joint definitions atomically. Fixed, prismatic, revolute and arc-length path joints use explicit local frames in metres, normalized xyzw quaternions and unit axes. Moving joints require limits and initial coordinates in m or rad. Paths use metre line/arc segments with continuous tangents and a nonparallel up direction; closed tracks distribute transport roll to close their orientation seam. Path coordinates are arc length in metres. Base joints form a spanning tree. Optional residual constraints solve declared passive joints for coordinate ratios, point coincidence, distance, aligned axes and closing hinge frames. Initial coordinates select the assembly branch. Limits, singularities, infeasible targets and uncertifiable motion reject the request; optional collision blocking requires conservative BRep-verified proxies for every instance. Compound box/sphere pieces preserve openings; bounds proxies can fill them.

tools.description: List/start_recording/finish_recording/cancel_recording/select/leave/delete revision-bound motion recordings. Uses explicit workspace, current revision and expected pose version. Records every accepted simulation tick or manipulation target, with mm poses, joint coordinates and monotonic seconds. Completed recordings persist locally and travel with native project Save/Open; design geometry stays unchanged. Imported current-design recordings rebind only after the first explicit rebuild verifies source inputs, exact geometry/publication fingerprints and sample compatibility. Changed designs retain stale archived recordings. Up to 3600 frames/32768 body-frames per recording, 8 MiB each, 16 recordings/64 MiB per workspace; capacity truncation is explicit. Select an existing frame for exact pose-tagged inspection/export; live manipulation/simulation is frozen until leave restores its prior pose. Another revision's recording cannot be applied. List returns metadata; select also returns bounded frame times. Finish recording before switching modes.

tools.description: Start/advance/motor/loads/stop fixed-step f64 Simulate mode at an explicit revision and expected pose version. Start requires explicit fixed/dynamic bodies, mass in kg or density in kg/m³, friction, restitution and gravity in m/s², plus BRep-verified collision proxies. Fixed/prismatic/revolute trees and closing hinge, coincident-point, fixed-distance and aligned-axis constraints are supported. Revolute and prismatic gear couplings are enforced as workless coordinate constraints, including parallel-axis inertia for offset hinges and optional backlash tooth contact. Prescribed paths are integrated along arc length using tangent mass and frame inertia; on-track contact impulses from the Rapier tick project onto the path speed. get_motion reports simulation_unavailable_reason when a mechanism cannot be simulated. Hinge limits must stay within −π..π. Closure residuals measure actual physical poses and never certify a geometric swept path. Passive joints cannot be motor targets. Advance takes 1..120 ticks at 1/120 s; returns adjacent authoritative frames for rendering. Motors use force-based bounded springs in N or N m and m/rad targets. Stop restores the pre-simulation manipulation pose. Simulated contacts and proxy inertias are approximate; exact pose-tagged CAD queries/exports remain available. The loads command atomically replaces all persistent world-space body loads: force_n (N) acts at the center of mass and torque_nm (N m) is an independent couple. Only dynamic bodies accept loads; each component must be finite and at most 1e9 in absolute value. Empty loads clears all external loads. Loads persist across ticks without accumulating on repeated replacement, and stop clears the simulation. Simulation never rewrites design geometry.

oneOf.description: Replace all persistent external loads. An empty map clears them all.

tools.description: Create/list/edit/delete/run/replay saved CAD simulation tests from natural-language intent. List first for catalog CAS. Ground body/joint IDs in get_project/get_motion; inspect the full mechanism before defining actions. Upsert saves a named intent, explicit initial coordinates for every moving joint (m/rad), body masses/friction/gravity, timed motor/load actions and measurable checks. Ask the user to resolve missing targets/tolerances rather than inventing a requirement. Every list/run/upsert reply includes tests[].review: the original requirement, plain-language acceptance statements, Met/Not met per check, and measured values — use that review when explaining the test; do not rephrase thresholds. Run uses a fresh private 1/120 s simulation and never changes live poses or geometry. Run waits for completion; start_run returns a queued run ID immediately. List reports the latest queued/running/cancelling/completed/cancelled/failed operation. After start_run, poll list for that same run ID to become terminal before interpreting results. Existing outcomes belong to the previous run while an operation is active. Completed means execution finished; outcome.passed determines assertion success. cancel_run takes that exact workspace-scoped run_id, requires its actor or the local user, and needs no catalog/revision freshness. Stop preserves the previous result and stays cancelling until entered CPU work ends. Actor revocation cancels owned runs. There is one active run per workspace, two per actor and eight per application; queued and cancelling runs count. A 60-second wall deadline signals cancellation at safe tick boundaries; it is not a hard thread kill. Push requires direct signed normal contact, final receiver displacement and additional displacement versus an identical run without the selected driver motor. Contact threshold is peak sampled last-solver-substep impulse in N s, not force or total impulse. Approximate verified collision proxies/inertia only. Reports pass/fail measurements with thresholds; results become stale when revision/engine changes. Replay selects an accepted frame into canonical playback for visual and exact pose inspection; use control_playback leave to restore live pose. Up to 16 tests, 10 seconds/run, 32768 body-frames and 8 MiB catalog. Definitions travel with Save/Open; imported runs must be rerun. CAD simulation only.

tools.description: Export the committed model to STEP or STL at the authoritative motion pose; return an opaque artifact handle. Moving mechanisms require the current pose_version from get_motion. STL uses binary float32 millimetre coordinates and private fresh tessellation with absolute linear deflection setting 0.025 mm and angular setting 0.1 rad. Nonzero facets that collapse/reverse under float32 or triangulation vertices rounded by more than 0.025 mm reject the export without publication; use STEP or explicitly reposition the design. Degenerate kernel seams are removed and normals match exported vertices. These are meshing settings, not a certified universal surface-error bound; exact CAD geometry is unchanged. STEP retains exact CAD surfaces.
